title: Which loading and unloading steps still need manual work on an aluminium cylinder solution-treatment furnace?
summary: Rapid lowering does not replace confirmation of upper/lower rack connections and tank position. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s September 2023 aluminium cylinder solution-furnace proposal coordinates lifting with a forced pull-down mechanism in the tank. Transfer is timed from door opening to complete immersion, while both the upper lifting hook and lower wire-rope hook are explicitly connected manually. Include these manual steps on the same operating diagram when assessing the complete sequence.
